# Re0

> Re0 is your data asset agent for life, work and business: every answer cites its source, and every version is verifiable.

A data asset is one source -- a website, a GitHub repository, an uploaded file or a Notion page -- turned into immutable, citable versions. Re0 provides a public asset directory, an online retrieval playground and a REST API. Public assets can be explored without an account. Authenticated users create and manage assets, API keys, access rules and usage from the private dashboard.

Core product principles:

- Fresh: source changes create new immutable asset versions.
- Trustworthy: public assets pass a security scan before they publish.
- Traceable: retrieved context retains its source, document, section and version.
- Verifiable: version digests are anchored on Aptos so third parties can verify them independently.
- Predictable: API usage is billed per accepted call, not per token.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://re0.io/): Product overview and featured data assets.
- [Asset directory](https://re0.io/libraries): Browse and search public data assets.
- [Online playground](https://re0.io/playground): Try retrieval against public assets (sending a question requires sign-in).
- [Pricing](https://re0.io/pricing): The free allowance and Additional Calls packs.
- [About](https://re0.io/about): Re0's purpose, principles and product scope.
- [Service status](https://re0.io/status): Current retrieval, indexing and refresh status.
- [Contact](https://re0.io/contact): Support, claims, partnerships and security contacts.
- [Legal](https://re0.io/legal): Index of the two legal documents.
- [Terms of service](https://re0.io/legal/terms): Accounts, acceptable use, content and copyright, billing, call packs, refund policy and liability.
- [Privacy notice](https://re0.io/legal/privacy): What Re0 collects, how it is used and shared, retention, cookies and your rights.

## Agent and developer access

- [REST API](https://re0.io/api/v1): Versioned API namespace. Authentication is required for non-public or account-scoped operations.
- [Agent Skills index](https://re0.io/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Machine-readable discovery for retrieval, publishing and ownership workflows.

Every content page also has a compact Markdown representation: append `.md` to its path before the query string, for example `https://re0.io/libraries.md?q=next.js` or `https://re0.io/about.md`.

The retrieval flow has two stages: resolve an asset ID, then query that asset. Returned context includes citations and version information. Private assets and dashboard data require authorization and must not be crawled or inferred from public content.

## Notes for automated systems

- Prefer canonical URLs on `https://re0.io`.
- Treat public asset detail pages under `/libraries/` as the authoritative human-readable descriptions of those assets.
- Do not crawl `/dashboard`, `/admin`, `/api`, `/files`, `/login` or ownership-claim workflows.
- See [robots.txt](https://re0.io/robots.txt) for crawler rules and [sitemap.xml](https://re0.io/sitemap.xml) for indexable top-level pages.
